You will be working in a modern, high-tech warehouse where accuracy, efficiency and teamwork are essential. Do you enjoy working in a dynamic environment, have an eye for detail and take pride in delivering high-quality work? Are you a reliable team player who knows how to get things done? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!  Wie zoeken we?  What do we expect from you? You are a reliable, motivated and proactive team player with a strong sense of responsibility. You work accurately, take initiative and understand the importance of safety and quality in a warehouse environment. You can work independently as well as part of a team and stay focused in a fast-paced environment. To be successful in this role, you have: - A strong understanding of warehouse safety procedures. - A good command of English. - Basic computer and scanner skills. - Experience in outbound logistics and order picking. - At least 2 years of experience operating a reach truck in a warehouse environment. - A valid Reach Truck and EPT certificate.  Wat bieden wij je? Evening shift: 15:00-00:00. - Travel reimbursement. - A 13th-month salary. - An annual bonus based on company results. Would you like to work in a beautiful and modern building? Do you enjoy rolling up your sleeves? And do you work accurately? Then get started as a warehouse employee! You will earn €14.99 to €16.49 per hour and build up a pension from day 1. Additionally, you will receive a travel allowance, and there are regular fun team outings! There are also plenty of opportunities within the organization! You'd want to work here, wouldn't you?! Apply quickly! #mkbWhat we offer- Earn € 14,99 - € 16,49 per hour!- Chance of a direct contract!- Great team!- Diverse role!- Modern location in beautiful Helmond!- Travel allowance!Who you areAs warehouse employee you're an active go-getter! Do you have a passion for technology? And do you enjoy working accurately? We are looking for a true team player. Someone who likes being physically active and has an eye for a safe working environment. You learn quickly, and if you have an interest in computers, this is the place for you!And furthermore:- You have a good command of the Dutch or English language;- You are available 40 hours per week;- You are able to work in the Helmond area.What will you doAs warehouse worker your workday starts with a nice cup of coffee or tea. You have a friendly chat with your colleagues. After that, you get onto the floor full of energy! As a warehouse employee, you are the indispensable engine behind the complete flow of goods for the latest IT equipment. The teams rotate weekly between inbound, outbound, and inventory management. So your work is very diverse!In the morning, you start by receiving, sorting, and thoroughly checking the incoming shipments. This way, you make sure all products end up neatly and safely in their right places. After a nice break, you head out with a list to gather the right products and prepare them for shipping. You end the day by leaving the warehouse clean and organized together with your team. Then you head home with a satisfied feeling and fit muscles!

Fellowship in Paintings Conservation SRAL is offering a fellowship (full-time, 40h) in the Paintings Conservation Department. The one-year fellowship will commence on May 1st, 2027 and include a monthly stipend of €2850,- gross. SRAL Fellowship in Paintings Conservation Working under the guidance of the SRAL conservators the fellow will focus on practical conservation and restoration treatments as well as on a research project. The fellow will work as part of the team and participate in the daily activities of the conservation studio, focusing on easel paintings on canvas and possibly panel. Also, they may have the opportunity to join conservation work on site. The intern will carry out a range of conservation treatments including technical examination, photographic as well as written documentation. They also will be encouraged to participate in the decision-making processes. Participation in workshops, lectures and occasional studio visits will contribute to the fellowship programme. Although the research project's initial outline will be provided by SRAL conservators, its ultimate direction and scope will be decided in close consultation with the fellow. Eligibility Applicants hold a master's degree in conservation. They should have a maximum of two years of professional experience post-graduation. Alongside proficiency in English a demonstrated aptitude for research and writing is an advantage. The position is open to candidates of all nationalities. Candidates are responsible for securing visas and other permits for their stay and work in the Netherlands. (SRAL is not a registered sponsor at IND). Application Procedure Interested applicants must submit the following documents in English (or Dutch): • Curriculum vitae: A CV including basic biographical information and details of previous conservation experience and internships. • Letter of interest and intent: A personal statement outlining your motivation for the fellows...

Join an international organisation in the medical technology sector, supporting customers across Europe from its distribution centre in Venlo. As a Logistics Engineer, you will optimise logistics processes, drive continuous improvement and contribute to innovative, future-proof supply chain solutions. Wie zoeken we? Bachelor's degree in Logistics Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management or a related field. 4–7 years of experience in logistics engineering, warehouse engineering or process improvement. Strong knowledge of warehouse and distribution processes, including inbound, outbound, inventory management and value-added services. Experience with ERP/WMS systems; SAP is preferred. Strong data analysis skills, including Excel and Power BI. Knowledge of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies; Green Belt is preferred. Experience with process optimization, automation or logistics technology. Fluent in English; Dutch is an advantage. Wat bieden wij je? An annual gross salary of 75K per year, depending on experience and qualifications. An impactful engineering role within an international logistics environment. The opportunity to shape and improve complex distribution processes. Exposure to automation, digitalization and continuous improvement projects. Close collaboration with international stakeholders across Operations, Engineering, Quality and Supply Chain. The opportunity to contribute directly to the performance and future development of a European Distribution Centre. Functieomschrijving In this role, you will analyse and improve warehouse and distribution processes, with a focus on productivity, quality, efficiency and scalability. You will identify bottlenecks, translate operational data into improvements and lead projects that strengthen overall performance. Your responsibilities include: Analyse logistics processes and identify opportunities for improvement. Develop and implement process improvements using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies. Creacapacity, productivity and performance models using operational data. Support automation, digitalisation and system implementations. Work with ERP, WMS and other logistics systems to improve operational performance. Develop and maintain SOPs, work instructions and process documentation. Lead improvement projects in collaboration with Operations, Quality, IT and Supply Chain.

Today we have seven shops by the station, and our goal is still the same: to make someone's day a little better, with good coffee, honest food and a moment of rest. As Store Manager, you lead an international team of 25 to 30 people and make sure that happens, every day.  What you will do - Lead and coach your team, and help new colleagues learn something new every shift. - Plan the roster and keep labour costs on track. - Order once a week, based on data, so we keep waste low. - Keep quality, hygiene and service at the Lebkov standard. - Work on the floor as one team: we do everything together, at the coffee machine, the counter and in the kitchen.  Who you are - You are positive. Specialist in Agri & Food Recruitment  Productieleider Groente en Fruit Coach a diverse team and organize production in a growing packaging facility within the greenhouse horticulture sector.  About the employee  - Horticulture - Secondary vocational education, Bachelor degree - 38 hours - Asten  Your tasks As a Fruit and Vegetable Production Manager, you are present on the production floor every day, leading a team of approximately 25 to 60 employees. You'll ensure effective planning, a smooth production process, and a team that works together harmoniously and effectively. You'll coach, guide, and motivate employees with diverse language backgrounds. You'll create the order and production schedules and make adjustments as plans change. You monitor productivity, quality, and progress, and identify areas where processes can be improved. You coordinate with colleagues in sales, quality control, staffing, and logistics.
